magic_link.subject: Your Skyclause sign-in link
magic_link.body:
Use this one-time link to sign in to Skyclause: {url}

It expires at {expiresAt}. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email.

magic_link_disabled.subject: Magic-link sign-in is off
magic_link_disabled.body: Magic-link sign-in is off for your Skyclause account. Use another sign-in method to continue.

link_google.subject: Confirm your Google sign-in
link_google.body:
A Google account with this email was used to sign in to Skyclause. Confirm that it is yours to link it to your account: {url}

This one-time link expires at {expiresAt}. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
